description_en: Exports a custom image to an OSS bucket in the same region as the custom image
description_zh: 导出一份自定义镜像到与自定义镜像同一地域的OSS Bucket里
kebab_example: aliyun ecs export-image --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --image-id m-bp67acfmxazb4p0000 --oss-bucket testexportImage --region cn-hangzhou
name: ExportImage

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the custom image. You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 自定义镜像的地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/25609.html查看最新的阿里云地域列表。
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the custom image
parameters.name: image_id

parameters.help_en: The OSS bucket in which to store the exported image
parameters.name: oss_bucket

parameters.help_en: The prefix for the OSS object. The prefix can contain digits and letters and must be 1 to 30 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 您的OSS  Object的前缀。可以由数字或者字母组成，字符长度为1~30
parameters.name: oss_prefix

parameters.help_en:
The format in which to export the image. Valid values:
raw
vhd
qcow2
vmdk
vdi

Default value: raw
parameters.help_zh:
镜像文件的导出格式。取值范围：
raw。
vhd。
qcow2。
vmdk。
vdi。

默认值：raw
parameters.name: image_format

parameters.help_en: The name of the RAM role used to export the image
parameters.help_zh: 导出镜像时使用的RAM角色名称
parameters.name: role_name

TaskId.description_en: The ID of the image export task
